segments.an6.105:1.1: “Tayome, bhikkhave, bhavā pahātabbā, tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitabbaṃ.
segments.an6.105:1.3: Kāmabhavo, rūpabhavo, arūpabhavo – ime tayo bhavā pahātabbā.
segments.an6.105:1.6: Adhisīlasikkhāya, adhicittasikkhāya, adhipaññāsikkhāya – imāsu tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitabbaṃ.
segments.an6.105:1.8: Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ime tayo bhavā pahīnā honti, imāsu ca tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitasikkho hoti – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassā”ti.

lines: Aṭṭhame mettā etassa atthīti mettāvā, tassa bhāvo mettāvatā, mettāpaṭipatti, tāya.
Sā pana mettāvatā mettāvasena pāricariyāti āha “mettāyuttāya pāricariyāyā”ti.
Pariciṇṇasatthukena sāvakena nāma satthuno yāva dhammena kātabbā pāricariyā, tāya sammadeva sampāditattā.
